class.name: WorldBeaverDam3D
class.brief_description: A beaver dam whose failure leaves a beaver meadow in the stand.
class.description: While the dam holds, its pond stands. When it fails ([method breach], or [member state] set to [constant DAM_BREACHED]) the pond drains, and the flat it leaves is a beaver meadow: the dam adds a [constant WorldStand.DISTURBANCE_BEAVER] disc of [member pond_radius] round itself to [method WorldContracts.get_stand], [member years_drained] old, and removes it when it leaves the tree. Vegetation grows the meadow from it and trees leave the open ground to succession. Abandoned beaver ponds drain within a few years and stay sedge meadow for decades (Naiman et al. 1988; Johnston and Naiman 1990).

method.name: breach
method.description: The dam fails now (a flood over it, a debris flow, the beavers gone): the pond drains and the meadow starts at 0 years. Emits [signal breached].

method.name: get_disturbance_id
method.description: The stand disturbance this dam holds while breached, [code]0[/code] while it holds.

members.member: The pond's radius (m): the meadow it leaves.
Whether the dam holds or has failed.
Years since the pond drained (the meadow's age); [method WorldStand.advance_years] ages it further.

signal.name: breached
signal.description: The dam failed and its pond drained.

constants.constant: The dam holds; the pond stands.
The dam has failed; the pond is a beaver meadow.
